# Why I'm Running
As a parent of two daughters in SSFUSD, I want what every parent wants: strong schools, supported teachers, and an education that prepares our children for their future.
But too many students are struggling with reading and math, and academic progress has been too slow. This just isn’t good enough for our kids.
I’m running to change that. I bring more than 20 years of finance experience and a commitment to asking hard questions, listening to educators and families, and making sure our spending puts students first.
My priorities are:
Get the basics right. Strengthen reading, writing and math, help struggling students early, and give families clear progress reports.
Support teachers and staff. Give educators the resources and time to help students succeed.
Make every dollar count. Hold budgets and bond spending accountable, and plan for declining enrollment before it forces rushed cuts.
Build a path for every student. Expand college preparation, vocational classes, internships and apprenticeships.
Keep schools safe and welcoming. Support student mental health and classrooms where every child can learn.
Give families a real voice. Involve parents before major decisions are made.
Our students need results. Our teachers need support. Our families deserve a voice.
SUPPORT THE CAMPAIGN

# Support the Campaign
#### OUR STUDENTS. OUR SCHOOLS. OUR FUTURE.

#### Donate to the Campaign
# Make a Donation
Every donation, big or small, helps get our message to more voters and keeps this campaign focused on what matters: our students and schools.
Thank you for investing in their future.
# Order a Yard Sign
A yard sign is one of the easiest ways to show your support and help spread the word in our neighborhood.
Email us your name, mailing address, and how many you'd like, and we'll get them to you right away.
Request a Yard Sign
# Get in Touch
Have a question about the campaign, an idea to share, or just want to introduce yourself? I'd love to hear from you.
# Join our Email List
This campaign is powered by neighbors like you. Sign up for updates from Avin on upcoming events, volunteer opportunities, and the issues that matter most to South San Francisco students and families.
